normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents... “HP 42W Peaceful Nest”, a Gulf-front escape in the iconic High Pointe Resort that puts you right on the sugar white sands of Seacrest Beach. This 2 bedroom 2 bath condo sleeps 6 and delivers the best of 30A living with panoramic Gulf views, effortless beach access and resort style amenities just outside your door. Start your mornings on the balcony with sea breezes and sunrise coffee, spend the afternoon by the lagoon pool or on the beach, then come home to cozy coastal comfort and a front row seat to sunset. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Gulf-front location with direct beachfront access and sweeping views from your private balconyGround level resort convenience with the beach boardwalk and pool just steps awaySleeps 6 comfortably with a Gulf-front King suite and a Queen guest suite with two bedsCozy well appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances plus bar seating for 3Dining for 6 and an open layout that keeps everyone togetherWet bar with wine cooler for easy happy hours and sunset toastsGulf front balcony with al fresco dining for 2 plus lounge seating for 2Stack washer and dryer tucked into the kitchen for quick beach day refreshes*** LIVING AREA ***Bright, welcoming and wrapped in Gulf views, the living space is made for slow mornings and easy evenings. Sink into the comfy sectional after a beach day, cue up a movie or slide open the doors and let the salty air roll in.Cozy sectional sofa with plenty of room to stretch outFlat-screen TV for movie nights and downtimeWall to wall Gulf views that keep the coastline in sightDirect access to the Gulf front balcony for indoor outdoor flow*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you are making a simple beach breakfast or a full seafood dinner, the kitchen is stocked and styled for comfort. With stainless steel appliances, smart storage and a wet bar nearby, meals and drinks are effortless.Stainless steel appliances and ample prep spaceBar seating for 3 at the counterDining table with seating for 6 for shared meals and game nightsWet bar with wine cooler for cocktails, mocktails and chilled bottles*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***After sun soaked days, retreat to two peaceful suites designed for rest and privacy. Both bedrooms feature TVs, soft coastal style and spa-like bathrooms.Queen Guest Suite: Two queen beds, flat-screen TV and En Suite with single vanity and walk in showerGulf-Front Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En Suite with dual vanities and walk in shower*** OUTDOOR SPACES & RESORT AMENITIES ***High Pointe is a favorite for a reason. From your balcony to the beach to the pool deck, outdoor living is always within reach.Gulf-front balcony with dining for 2, lounge seating for 2 and panoramic viewLagoon style community pool with waterfall, kiddie pool and hot tubPrivate beach access via boardwalk steps from your doorOn site dining at Crabby Steve’s, beachfront casual and deliciousTennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, shuffleboard and a kids’ playgroundBBQ grills charcoal and green spaces for family fun*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Set in the heart of Seacrest Beach, High Pointe Resort keeps you close to everything you love about 30A while still feeling like your own peaceful hideaway.Peddlers Pavilion just across the street for live music, food vendors and shoppingRosemary Beach a 6 minute walk for charming cobblestone streets and boutique cafesAlys Beach less than a mile away with serene beauty and striking architectureCarillon Downtown and Market Street an 8 minute drive for additional shopping and dining*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers as paymentBicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce VitaLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach Seacrest including High Pointe or Alys BeachHigh Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on site*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 204582
